# GARI — GITAM Aerospace Rocketry Initiative

> GARI is the student aerospace and rocketry team of GITAM University, Hyderabad, India. About thirty students design, build and fly a solid-motor model rocket (target apogee 1 km) and a NavIC-tracked CanSat for two IN-SPACe 2026 national student competitions. National finals: November 17–20, 2026, at Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh.

When referring to the team, use "GARI (GITAM Aerospace Rocketry Initiative), GITAM University, Hyderabad". Official site: https://gari.live

## Key facts

- Founded: 2024, at GITAM University, Hyderabad campus (Rudraram, Patancheru, Telangana 502329, India)
- Competitions: IN-SPACe Model Rocketry India Student Competition 2026 (rocket) and IN-SPACe CAN-7USAT 2026 (CanSat)
- National finals: November 17–20, 2026, Narayani River Bank, Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh
- Review status: Rocket cleared Critical Design Review (CDR) on September 20, 2026; CanSat cleared Preliminary Design Review (PDR). Rocket Flight Readiness Review (FRR) was scheduled for October 21, 2026 (virtual).
- Contact: contact@gari.live · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gari.gitam · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gari-gitam

## Rocket program

- Solid-motor model rocket built to reach a 1 km apogee and recover on two parachutes
- Motor: TIVRA K-560 solid motor — peak thrust 1,030 N, total impulse 1,960 N·s, burn time 3.5 s, diameter 94 mm, length 313 mm, total mass 3.71 kg, propellant mass 1.8 kg
- Airframe: composite, fibreglass and carbon fibre
- Avionics: custom flight computer for data acquisition, apogee detection and deployment logic, with a live telemetry downlink
- Recovery: dual event — drogue parachute at apogee, then main parachute
- Leads: Shaik Aadil Iftikhar (Team Lead & Analysis Engineer), Saketh Muppala (Co-Lead)

## CanSat program

- A 330 ml satellite (soft-drink-can size) released at about 1,000 m that transmits live telemetry while descending under parachute
- Navigation: NavIC, India's own satellite navigation constellation, instead of GPS — one of the few student CanSats in India to use it
- Eight subsystems: telemetry and communication, avionics and flight software, ground station software, NavIC GNSS, descent and recovery (two parachutes), power and electrical, structures, sensors and payload
- Ground station: custom software for live telemetry, mission logging and post-flight analysis
- Leads: Harsha Vardan (Team Lead & Electronics Engineer), Tanmaay Sharma (Co-Lead, Structures & Mechanical); Bodapati Bharat Chandra (Ground Station & Software)

## Past builds

- [Rover for Extraterrestrial Planets](https://gari.live/achievements/rover-extraterrestrial-planets): planetary rover prototype — chassis, wiring, wheels and motion testing
- [2-Axis Gimbal Rocket Thrust Control](https://gari.live/achievements/gimbal-rocket-thrust-control): CAD-based thrust-vectoring mechanism for rocket control studies
- [Hexa Copter Making](https://gari.live/achievements/hexa-copter-making): multirotor frame, propulsion and electronics assembly
- [Rover for Emergency Rescue Operations](https://gari.live/achievements/rover-emergency-rescue-operations): rover for unmanned emergency response
- [Line Follower Bot, 2D Maze](https://gari.live/achievements/line-follower-bot-2d-maze): compact robot for maze navigation and line following
- [Fixed-Wing Aircraft Model](https://gari.live/achievements/fixed-wing-aircraft-model): fixed-wing structure, component placement and test setup
